forwho.title: A good fit if the plan keeps outgrowing the week
yes: You set goals every January and lose the thread by February.

no: You want daily motivation or a pep talk. This is a planner you fill in.

faq.a: A PDF planner for print or tablet (48 pages, fully linked on a tablet), plus a Google Sheet with a dashboard and a Notion template. Everything arrives as one instant download on Gumroad.

faq.q: How much time does it take each week?
faq.a: 105 minutes: two 45-minute blocks for your three dimensions and a fifteen-minute Sunday review. The first week has six short sessions in 00 Start here.

faq.q: Do I have to fill in all twelve dimensions?
faq.a: You score all twelve once, then pick three to work on. The other nine stay on a short maintenance minimum, so you are not asked to improve everything at once.
Anyone who wants one plan for work, money and people and keeps losing it by February. It suits a tablet or a printer.

faq.q: What are the Guided Sunday Reviews?
faq.a: Thirteen short guided reviews, written as scripts you read through each Sunday.

faq.q: Is this financial or career advice?
faq.a: No. It is a planning tool and general education, not financial, legal, employment or mental-health advice.
